Ambrose Bierce, Poetry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/ambrose-bierce/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Ambrose Bierce, the annotator and author and writer of the preface, died 1914 (citizenship: United States).

First publication of the text used: not given as a year in the colophon (SE colophon: 'Poetry was compiled from poetry published between 1867 and 1914 by Ambrose Bierce.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the colophon gives no first publication year for this compiled text (it says the text was compiled from poetry published between 1867 and 1914), so the United States side rests on the edition's rights statement quoted below.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts): the work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1914.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
